summary: Frontend-only verification of 5 newly added service subpages (Schmerztherapie, Infusionstherapie, Stosswelle, Stammzelle, Postoperativ) for OA Dr. Ewald Walder static site at http://localhost:3000. All subpages, hero images, navigation, accordions, accessibility toggle, and homepage service-card links pass. No console errors, no network failures (>=400). One minor a11y note on accordion trigger aria-expanded.

a11y_minor.issue: toggleAccordion(index) in script.js only toggles the '.open' class on .accordion-content and '.rotated' on .accordion-icon. It does NOT update aria-expanded on the .accordion-trigger button (hardcoded aria-expanded="false" in HTML stays 'false' forever). Visual behavior is correct, but screen readers will not announce expanded/collapsed state.
a11y_minor.suggested_fix: In toggleAccordion(index), also do: document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-trigger').forEach(t => t.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')); then on the opened one: document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-trigger')[index].setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');

verifications: All 5 subpages return HTTP 200: schmerztherapie.html, infusionstherapie.html, stosswelle.html, stammzelle.html, postoperativ.html.
All 5 hero images return HTTP 200: schmerztherapie-hero.jpg, infusionstherapie-hero.jpg, stosswelle-hero.jpg, stammzelle-hero.jpg, postoperativ-hero.jpg.

Homepage #leistungen has 5 anchor cards with correct hrefs and data-testids: service-link-schmerztherapie -> schmerztherapie.html, service-link-infusionstherapie -> infusionstherapie.html, service-link-stosswelle -> stosswelle.html, service-link-stammzelle -> stammzelle.html, service-link-postoperativ -> postoperativ.html.
On each subpage [data-testid='subpage-hero'] is visible with inline background-image set to the correct hero JPG (e.g., schmerztherapie-hero.jpg).

Breadcrumb on each subpage contains 'Startseite / Leistungen / <Current>' with correct current title (Schmerztherapie, Infusionstherapie, Stoßwelle, Stammzelle (ACP) Therapie, Post Operative Behandlung).
H1 present on each subpage (e.g., 'Schmerztherapie in Wien', 'Infusionstherapie in Wien', 'Post-Operative Behandlung in Wien' etc.).
[data-testid='hero-booking-btn'] visible with text 'Termin vereinbaren'. Uses onclick='openBooking()' (tel:012141431) per spec — not invoked in headless browser.
[data-testid='back-to-services'] href = 'index.html#leistungen' on all 5 subpages. Clicking it returns to homepage Leistungen anchor.
[data-testid='header-logo-link'] href = 'index.html#top' on all 5 subpages. Clicking returns to homepage.

FAQ accordion verified on all 5 subpages: clicking .accordion-trigger toggles .open class on the corresponding .accordion-content (one open/close cycle: before=closed, after-click=open, after-second-click=closed).

[data-testid='accessibility-toggle'] verified on all 5 subpages: clicking adds 'accessibility-mode' to body.className and computed background-image on .subpage-hero becomes 'none' (hero bg removed, page stays readable).
Section structure on each subpage: 1x .section-dark CTA band, 1x .aside-card 'Termin vereinbaren' card, footer present.
Lucide icons render correctly on every subpage (31-34 SVGs each).
Zero console errors and zero network responses >= 400 across all 5 subpages during full interaction flow.
action_items: (Optional, LOW priority) Update toggleAccordion() in /app/static-website/script.js to also sync aria-expanded on the .accordion-trigger buttons for screen-reader correctness — visual behavior is already correct.
critical_code_review_comments: toggleAccordion does not update aria-expanded on the trigger button — the attribute is statically set to 'false' in HTML and never changes, which is misleading for assistive tech. Visual behavior is fine.
Hero images are served as full-resolution JPGs without responsive sizes/AVIF/WebP variants — same perf observation as iteration_1 for ueber-bg.png; not blocking but worth a follow-up.

5 subpages duplicate a substantial amount of header/footer/CTA/aside/footer markup. If the site grows, consider a tiny templating/build step (e.g., 11ty/handlebars/include) to DRY this up; for now, acceptable for a static site.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all functional checks pass; 1 minor a11y note)

context_for_next_testing_agent: 5 service subpages live and verified at http://localhost:3000/{schmerztherapie|infusionstherapie|stosswelle|stammzelle|postoperativ}.html. All cross-page links (service-link-*, back-to-services, header-logo-link) confirmed. Accordion toggles via the '.open' class — do NOT assert via aria-expanded (currently not synced; minor a11y issue logged). Booking buttons trigger tel:012141431 — do not expect HTTP nav on click.
rca of the issue: n/a — no blocking bugs found. The only minor finding (accordion aria-expanded not synced) is an a11y oversight in script.js#toggleAccordion: it manipulates classList on content/icon but never calls setAttribute('aria-expanded', ...) on the trigger button.
